decisions.reason: Walks resolve(): snapshot succeeds without current, id undefined, returns null every keystroke, onKeyDown exits before preventDefault; explains both silences (all four probes survive; undefined is a legitimate quiet no-session state) without claiming service/guard removal.

Type-walks alpha.1 SessionListState{byId,current} vs alpha.2 snapshot without current, maps uiSession adapter.current to {key,ctx,hooks,keyedHooks,props} with key replacing current and ctx replacing scope(id).
Provides one-build resolver reading uiSession.adapter.current.getSnapshot() with legacy current+scope fallback, optional uiSession injection, scoped ctx used for conversation get and input.for.

Names field-level removal behind service-level stability checked once at activation; hardens with actual-capability probes (field presence / uiSession feature detect) re-run per binding change rather than presence-list expansion.
Covers binding-key probe, chord behavior on both hosts and fail-loud prevention, but never proposes typechecking the plugin against the alpha.2 published declarations as the pre-ship gate.
